title: Effect of Epigallocatechin Gallate on Glycemic Index: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials - ScienceDirect
abstract: August 29, 2025 - Although EGCG supplementation is associated with improvements in some glycemic parameters, these effects especially for HbA1c and fasting insulin are either modest or nonsignificant. The evidence does not strongly support the use of EGCG as a stand-alone intervention for glycemic control. Further high-quality, large-scale randomized controlled trials are required to clarify its potential benefits and clinical relevance.
